ModMetaData.name: RimMT RC2-T3 Lean
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RC2-T3 Lean convergence layer for RimMT 1.5. Removes RC2-T2 tail-only diagnostic Harmony patches after startup, suppresses the low-yield parallel WorkPrefilter path, keeps production S5.1/S5.3/Stage3/DoBill authority intact, and only attempts Stage4D pruning when a patch can be identified unambiguously as cleaning/path/opportunity-specific. Fail-closed: ambiguous or unknown production patches are left untouched.
